title: Checkout errors after a routine deployment
prompt: At 02:14 UTC checkout success fell from 99.8% to 71%. Customers see intermittent HTTP 503 responses. Identify the root cause and explain the causal path to the customer-visible symptom.

evidence.content: checkout HTTP 503 rate rose from 0.1% to 28.7% between 02:14 and 02:18; request volume remained within the normal weekday band.

evidence.summary: Payment memory climbs until each restart
evidence.content: payment-service RSS grew monotonically from 410 MiB at 02:06 to its 768 MiB container limit at 02:14. It reset to 190 MiB after each restart and began climbing again.

evidence.summary: Payment pod terminated for exceeding memory
evidence.content: Kubernetes event: container payment in pod payment-6c7b was terminated with reason OOMKilled; restart count advanced from 0 to 1.
Diagnostic log counters show receipt_cache entries increasing from 8,120 to 94,337 while evictions remain 0. Entries persist after payment completion.

evidence.summary: A receipt lookup cache was enabled
evidence.content: Release payment-service 4.18.0 enabled receipt_cache for faster duplicate-payment detection. No other checkout dependency changed in this deployment.
checkout-service CPU stayed at 31-38%, memory at 44%, and its pods did not restart during the incident.
Database query p95 was 18 ms, connections 42%, CPU 27%, and error count zero throughout 02:00-02:30.
